data.body:
Fix committed as 83ca81e709e (worktree win-ctypes-trim): `_malloc_trim()` returns None when `sys.platform` is not Linux. Evidence before push:
- New test `test_windows_has_no_trim_and_a_release_does_not_raise` fails on origin/main 57d45053272 with `TypeError: LoadLibrary() argument 1 must be str, not None`; passes with the fix (file: 4 passed, 1 skipped on macOS).
- With `ctypes.CDLL(None)` patched to raise that TypeError, the 16 files from job 133771119760: 47 failed on origin/main (superset of all 46 Windows failures); 318 passed, 0 failed with the fix.
`make verify` running now; push to Gerrit follows.
